Validity: Processors, RAM, storage devices, and other commodity components, as well as End of Life product prices are valid for 24 hours. All other pricing is valid for 14 days unless otherwise noted. Prices are for MOQ as stated.
Payment: Prepayment by Credit Card, Bank or Wire transfer required on all orders, unless credit terms are approved.
Lead Time: Lead times depend on order quantity and product availability.
Returns & Cancellations: Special Order items and items ordered in 5+ system quantities or 10+ component quantities are non-returnable and non-cancelable. Please see our complete Terms and Conditions at www.onlogic.com/terms
Warranty: Systems built and tested by OnLogic are covered under a two year warranty. Additional warranty plans are available.
